comparison.relative_reference: finer32x96 mesh; every nonzero point, no absolute tolerance floor

coarse_wave.scope: Same scalar Fourier-pupil model as v0.2.1; continuous requested-frequency autocorrelation. High-NA vector/polarization equivalence unverified.
coarse_wave.illumination: uniform Fourier-pupil amplitude; no Fresnel/absorption in lens-only MTF
coarse_wave.axis_convention: Y-field: T frequency along global sensor Y; S along global sensor X
coarse_wave.sensor_plane_conversion: local chief-normal projection; T frequency / chief_z_cosine, not exact tilted-plane vector diffraction
coarse_wave.interpolation_chart: unwrapped reference-sphere OPD linear on physical UV triangles; exact angular-to-UV inverse query
coarse_wave.interpolation_change: Original v0.2.1 interpolates linearly on straight direction-cosine triangles; this conditional variant preserves curved support through inverse UV lookup.
coarse_wave.integration_measure: uniform dchi*deta; original B=1 Fourier-pupil amplitude, no duplicate UV Jacobian
coarse_wave.boundary_projection_bound: 32768 radial interval upper envelopes, outward nextafter elementary arithmetic plus1e-12mm+64eps magnitude margin

geometric_diagnostic.method: geometric ray-intercept characteristic function; no diffraction

coarse_wave.necessary_note: Autocorrelation avoids wrapping/undersampled phase-field FFT, but unwrapped OPD interpolation still requires independent traced-mesh refinement.

sampling_diagnostics.edge_model: binary_midpoint_polygon; refine rings/arms and wave grid independently
